title: Houthis Claim Missile Strike on Riyadh Airport; Airlines Suspend Flights
detail: Houthi forces claimed a missile strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, with explosions reported across the Saudi capital. Multiple airlines suspended flights to Riyadh in response, marking a significant escalation of Houthi cross-border attacks on Saudi infrastructure.

title: UN, UK and Arab States Issue Joint Condemnation of Houthi Attacks on Saudi Airports
detail: The United Nations, United Kingdom, and multiple Arab states issued a joint condemnation of Houthi drone and missile attacks targeting Saudi airports, calling on Houthi forces to halt cross-border strikes on civilian infrastructure and urging de-escalation.

title: Saudi Arabia Confirms 3 Killed in Houthi Riyadh Airport Strike; Airport Reopens
detail: Saudi Arabia officially confirmed that three Saudi citizens were killed in Houthi missile strikes on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. The airport briefly closed following the attack but has since reopened. Separately, Pakistan clarified that its troops stationed in Saudi Arabia are not participating in any operations against the Houthis.
